items.headline: Adobe announced it will release Q2 FY2026 earnings after market close on Thursday, June 11, 2026.
Adobe completed its acquisition of Semrush and said it is integrating Semrush into Adobe CX Enterprise to expand SEO, GEO, and ASO capabilities.
Adobe announced a new $25 billion stock repurchase authorization through April 30, 2030.
Adobe announced an AI partnership with DICK’S Sporting Goods to personalize athlete experiences across stores, mobile, and web.
Adobe and Xfinity announced a partnership to embed Adobe Brand Intelligence into Xfinity’s creative workflow for personalized marketing and brand governance.
Adobe announced Adobe CX Enterprise Coworker, an agentic AI solution to orchestrate customer experience workflows across Adobe Experience Platform and partner AI platforms.
